findings.title: Additional VLAN on uplink
findings.description: The sample adds VLAN 30 to a trunk. Validate the intended service and segmentation context before considering a real change.
findings.detail: Prewritten fixture: allowed VLANs 10,20 → 10,20,30. No production policy, traffic or exposure has been measured.

backups.label: Snapshot 03
backups.config:

version 17.12
hostname CORE-SW-01
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description Primary distribution uplink
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30
!
ip access-list standard MANAGEMENT
 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
 deny any log
!
router ospf 10
 passive-interface default
 network 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
!
logging buffered 32768
ntp server 192.0.2.250
end
